seo.description: hansgrohe shower system and basin mixer installation in Ascot, fit-only from £3,500. We fit the valves and mixers you've specified, with water pressure and rough-in checked at survey.

hero.intro: hansgrohe turns up on more of the specification sheets we work from in Ascot than almost any other single brand, usually as the shower and basin mixer package running alongside sanitaryware from Duravit, Villeroy & Boch or Laufen. What decides how well that package performs once it's fitted has less to do with the brand itself — the engineering is consistent across hansgrohe's range, which keeps the fitting itself predictable — and more to do with water pressure, rough-in depth, and whether the valve body gets set correctly before the wall closes up. Ascot's large Victorian, Edwardian, inter-war and executive-style plots tend to hand us the kind of wall and floor void space that makes getting that rough-in right considerably easier than it would be in a smaller, more constrained property, though we still confirm the house's actual water system and supply pressure at survey rather than assuming a generous plot means an easy fit. We install hansgrohe fit-only: you specify and supply the shower system or basin mixer through your showroom or designer, and we handle the strip-out, first fix, tiling, plumbing and snagging that gets it performing the way it's designed to.

sections.heading: What we install from hansgrohe in Ascot
sections.body: In Ascot, hansgrohe most often arrives as the shower and basin mixer package on a specification that's already been through a showroom or designer — a thermostatic or manual shower valve and handset, a basin mixer tap, sometimes a bath filler, sitting alongside sanitaryware from Duravit, Villeroy & Boch or Laufen. Because the engineering is consistent across hansgrohe's range, the fitting itself doesn't vary wildly between one project and the next the way it can with brands that span several distinct product families. That consistency is useful for us at survey stage: once we've confirmed the water pressure available, the required rough-in depth and the valve type specified, the rest of the installation follows a predictable sequence rather than needing a different fitting approach for every product line. Whether the Ascot project is a full en-suite refit or a single shower valve replacement, the work is largely the same: strip out the old fittings, confirm first-fix positions, tile around the concealed valve body, then fit and commission the visible trim once the room is finished.

sections.heading: Why water pressure is the variable to get right
sections.body: Of the three things that actually decide how a hansgrohe installation performs — water pressure, rough-in depth and valve body position — water pressure is the one that's specific to the house rather than the fitting itself. A hansgrohe shower system that's been specified for a particular flow and pressure range needs the incoming water supply checked against that specification before installation, not after, because a mismatch shows up as poor performance that's expensive to trace back to its source once the room is tiled and finished. Rough-in depth and valve body position are both things we control directly during first fix, provided the tile thickness and wall build-up have been confirmed in advance, so a scuffed finish or a valve sitting at the wrong depth behind the tile is avoidable with the right sequencing. We check all three at the £125 survey, before any product is ordered or any wall closes up.

sections.heading: How Ascot's larger plots affect a typical hansgrohe installation
sections.body: Ascot's large detached Victorian, Edwardian, inter-war and executive-style houses generally give us more flexibility to plan a hansgrohe installation properly than a smaller or more constrained property would — relocating a waste run, widening a stud wall to the correct rough-in depth, or repositioning a shower valve rarely runs into the structural limits a terraced house would present. That flexibility helps with planning the work, but it doesn't change what decides whether the installation performs well once it's finished: the water pressure, the rough-in depth and the valve body position still have to be confirmed and got right, regardless of how much room the property gives us to work with. In an older Ascot property we also check the existing water system and any original pipe runs before committing to a valve position, since a larger plot doesn't automatically mean modern plumbing throughout the house.

sections.heading: Fit-only, from £3,500
sections.body: We install hansgrohe shower systems and basin mixers on a fit-only basis in Ascot — you choose and supply the products through your showroom or designer, and we handle the strip-out, first fix, tiling, plumbing and snagging. Installations start from £3,500, and every project begins with a fixed-price £125 survey, deducted from your project cost if you go ahead, where we confirm the water pressure, rough-in depth and valve specification your hansgrohe installation needs.

faqs.q: Do you supply hansgrohe products, or just fit them?
faqs.a: We fit only. You source your hansgrohe shower system or basin mixer through a showroom or designer, and we handle the installation — strip-out, first fix, tiling, plumbing and snagging — from £3,500.

faqs.q: Does Ascot's water supply affect how a hansgrohe shower performs?
faqs.a: It can. Water pressure is one of the main variables that decides how a hansgrohe shower system performs once fitted, so we check the property's incoming supply against the specified product's requirements at survey.

faqs.q: Will my large Ascot plot make a hansgrohe installation easier?
faqs.a: It generally gives us more flexibility to plan waste runs and valve positions, but it doesn't replace confirming water pressure, rough-in depth and valve body position — those still need to be right regardless of plot size.

faqs.q: What sanitaryware does hansgrohe usually get paired with?
faqs.a: On the projects we fit, hansgrohe shower and basin mixer packages most often sit alongside sanitaryware from Duravit, Villeroy & Boch or Laufen, though we work with whatever's been specified.

faqs.q: What does the £125 survey check before a hansgrohe installation?
faqs.a: We measure the room, confirm the water pressure and supply, check the rough-in depth needed for the specified valve, and establish what your Ascot property needs to fit it properly, before any quote is finalised.
